note: The fuzzer passes the raw ELF input bytes to dwarf_init_path, which parses the ELF file and triggers the debuglink processing path.
dwarf_init_path delegates to dwarf_init_path_dl with the raw input data.
dwarf_init_path_dl calls dwarf_object_init_path to initialize the DWARF object from the ELF data.
dwarf_object_init_path calls dwarf_object_init_b which processes the ELF sections including .gnu_debuglink.
dwarf_object_init_b initializes the ELF object access and reads section headers, including the .gnu_debuglink section.
The .gnu_debuglink section contains an empty name (first byte is NUL), so link_string_in points to the byte after the NUL, which is the padding byte (also NUL), making it an empty string.
dwarfstring_append is called with an empty string. Since strlen("")==0, dwarfstring_append_length returns early without resizing, so js_linkstring.s_data remains pointing to the global "" literal.
prepare_linked_name is called with js_linkstring as the linkname parameter, which points to the global empty string.
prepare_linked_name calls _dwarf_pathjoinl with the linkname pointing to the global empty string.
inputs is set to the global empty string literal "" (1-byte array containing just NUL).
targlen is non-zero because the target already contains the directory path from js_dirname.

is_full_path is called with inputs pointing to the global empty string. Inside is_full_path, path[0] reads the NUL byte, then path[1] reads one byte past the end of the 1-byte global "" literal, causing a global-buffer-overflow READ of 1 byte.
